text: This report recommends that the name "Kristen Fahrig Lane" be approved to identify a public lane located west of Lansdowne Avenue, extending northerly from Whytock Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Kristen Fahrig Lane" for a public lane located west of Lansdowne Avenue, extending northerly from Whytock Avenue.
